stem:
Harish takes an ice cube from the freezer onto a warm kitchen plate. After a few minutes he has a puddle of liquid water.

Which description of the change is correct?

options.text: The ice melted: solid water changed into liquid water as it was warmed.
The ice changed from solid to liquid by evaporation.
The ice would melt even if the kitchen air were at −10 °C, only because it left the freezer.
Warming the liquid water on the plate would make it freeze back into ice.

teacher.key_rationale: Melting is solid to liquid on warming. Evaporation is liquid to vapour; warming does not freeze.
